headline: Significant inflation jump in Poland. EC publishes forecasts
summary: The European Commission kept its 2026 GDP growth forecast for Poland at 3.5%. It cut 2027 growth to 2.7% from 2.8% and raised the 2027 inflation forecast to 4.4% from 2.9%.
why: Commission forecasts shape expectations for Poland's growth, inflation and central bank policy, which matter for zloty assets and Polish bonds.
original_headline: Spory skok inflacji w Polsce. KE opublikowała prognozy
